decision.reason: Pursue independent tiered preview delivery; keep custom video reconstruction optional, gated and removable. Individual path decisions and browser block are recorded separately.
decision.scope: Native synthetic component screen, not integrated browser preview qualification.

paths.basis: Pixel-exact prepared PNG controls are inexpensive; actual streaming/cache integration not measured.
Selected VP9 packets matched target thumbnails; isolated H264 coarse and exact cases matched their respective timestamps. Browser admission pending.
JPEG scaled decode positive; MPEG2 dimensions-only screen; no universal modern-video support in tested decoders.
H264/HEVC/VP9/AV1 stayed full-size in installed FFmpeg 7.1.5. Reopen only on an actual new decoder/profile implementation.
Bounded kernel correctness and speed benefit; no full decoder, pixel-fidelity, Wasm or hardware comparison.
Native first/final outputs reuse state and match final-only output; targeted optional path due total-work penalty and unmeasured memory/browser costs.
Navigation blocked by administrator; no GPU device. This is not evidence of codec support/failure.
